overloads.semanticRole: The WEB SEND HTTP REDIRECT command allows you to transform a URL into another one.

constraints: By default 4D URL-encodes special characters in url; passing the optional '*' parameter tells 4D not to translate them.
This command takes precedence over any data-sending command (WEB SEND FILE, WEB SEND BLOB, etc.) called in the same method -- the redirect wins.
Sends HTTP status 302 (Moved Temporarily); to send a 301 (Moved Permanently), set a 'HTTP X-STATUS: 301' field in the header of the reply instead.
